Barbie - Race & Ride.name: Barbie: Race & Ride
Barbie - Race & Ride.summary: Barbie makes her first appearance on the PlayStation with BARBIE RACE AND RIDE. Help Barbie take care of a stable of horses; groom the horses or feed them a variety of foods including apples, carrots, strawberries, and sugar cubes. After the steed is taken care of, go on a casual ride around Secret Valley. Explore the beaches, meadows, mountains, and forests to discover new animal friends, mini-games, and puzzles. Find the pieces of the missing postcard and discover the secret of Secret Valley. For those with a more competitive streak, enter a race or jumping contest.

Daikoukai Jidai IV - Porto Estado.name: Daikoukai Jidai IV: Porto Estado
Daikoukai Jidai IV - Porto Estado.summary: Daikōkai Jidai IV: Porto Estado is the fourth game in the Uncharted Waters/Daikōkai Jidai series about sailing and trading, themed around the Age of Discovery, mixing simulation with role-playing elements.

Disney's Action Game met Hercules.name: Disney's Hercules Action Game
Disney's Action Game met Hercules.summary: Disney's Hercules Action Game is a platform game mainly two-dimensional, although in many missions the player can walk to other planes via pathways or stairs. There are ten levels and three difficulty modes: Beginner, Medium, and Herculean. Hercules can jump, grab ledges, swing on poles, and jump while running. He has a variety of attack moves at his disposal.

E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial - Interplanet.name: E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial - Interplanetary Mission
E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial - Interplanet.summary:
E.T. may have left Earth safely onboard his spaceship, but trouble awaits him soon after landing in this 3D PlayStation adventure. The universe is in danger and only E.T. can help save it, by finding exotic plants. As the kind-hearted alien from the 1982 film, re-released in 2002 to commemorate its 20th anniversary, players must rescue rare plants from a total of five planets: Green Planet, Ice Planet, Desert Planet, Planet Metropolis, and Earth. Each planet contains a specific number of plants to find across three levels.

Worlds are also filled with hostile creatures or government agents, so E.T. needs to use his special powers to help him overcome all manner of threats. As E.T. walks and runs across the levels, he can call upon the power of telekinesis to move items closer, use his healing power to restore flowers, and unleash a heart stun to temporarily freeze enemies. Also available on each level are items such as keys or switches, which let E.T. access blocked areas. Progress in the adventure can be saved to a memory card.

Firebugs.name: Firebugs
Firebugs.summary: Welcome to the Firebugs racing season, where teams of different worlds send their best racer to compete for fame and glory. Play as Gismo, Karrie, Zero, BOW or Kami - each with a background story, unique special weapon, and alternate vehicle designs that can be unlocked. You race in five distinct worlds: a group of linked islands (Archipelago), a droid factory (Droid Gardens), a desert wasteland (Terrian Dunes), an industrial area (Sky Port) and a wealthy city (Aerial City). While racing, the personal weapon is stored in the left weapon bay. Random weapons that can be picked up by all racers are stored on the right.

Game of Life, The - DX Jinsei Game II.name: The Game of Life: DX Jinsei Game II
Game of Life, The - DX Jinsei Game II.summary: DX Jinsei Game II is a Miscellaneous game, published by Takara.

Gekitotsu Toma L'Arc - Tomarunner vs L'A.name: Gekitotsu Toma L'Arc: Tomarunner Vs L'Arc-en-Ciel
Gekitotsu Toma L'Arc - Tomarunner vs L'A.summary:
Gekitotsu Toma L'Arc: TomaRunner vs L'Arc-en-Ciel is a Japan-exclusive racing game for the PlayStation. It is the sequel to TomaRunner and includes members of the Japanese band L'Arc-en-Ciel as playable characters.

Each member of the band voices the in-game characters themselves. The L'Arc-en-Ciel songs that play within the game are "Driver's High", "Stay Away", "Route 666", "Trick", and "Niji".

The game was popular enough to receive a PS one Books re-release on December 21, 2001.

The dream has finally become reality with the help of L'Arc en Ciel! Every fan must have this! And of course, there is fun to be had with this game. This summer, why don't you try the Tomarunner experience for yourself?

Mahou Shoujo Fancy CoCo.name: Mahou Shoujo Fancy Coco
Mahou Shoujo Fancy CoCo.summary:
Coco is a young princess in a magical kingdom, which has a tradition of shape-shifting magic. Her father, the king, explains to her that she must study magic for three years, in order to prove herself worthy of being a true heiress to the throne. Whether Coco will succeed or not depends on the player!
Mahou Shoujo Fancy Coco is similar in gameplay to Princess Maker games: the main goal is to make schedules for the young princess, alternating between actually learning magic and having vacations. Every activity influences Coco's stats, which in their turn influence her advancement in magics.

Nainai no Meitantei.name: Nainai no Meitantei
Nainai no Meitantei.summary:
Nainai no Meitantei is an adventure game with real comedian cast. The game features the japanese comedian Yoshimoto and a new young actor that will help him solving the different cases that the game features.

In the game these detectives have to talk to different characters and looking for items and use them to find clues to solve those cases. The game features 3D graphics and japanese voice acting from the original comedians and actors.

The game features new locations when the player solve the first cases, and through the game there are some mini games like casino, racing, horse racing, etc. The game is full of wacky situations.

Sougaku Toshi Osaka.name: Noise City Osaka
Sougaku Toshi Osaka.summary:
Sougaku Toshi Osaka is a simulation game that takes place in the future in which the player can choose a party of 3 member from 6 different characters.

In the game the characters can improve their stats doing different jobs and activities each week meanwhille they go to different places of Osaka and there they can talk with different characters and go to shops and buy different items.

The gameplay use a first person perspective and use close up views when the player characters appear and when they talk to other characters. The game features different events during the weeks.

Spectral Force.name: Spectral Force
Spectral Force.summary: Spectral Force is the first in a long series of tactical role-playing games. This is a war simulation game set in "Neverland", where humans, gods, and the demon clans each wage war over the continents for their own visions of unity.

Tetris with Cardcaptor Sakura - Eternal.name: Tetris with Cardcaptor Sakura: Eternal Heart
Tetris with Cardcaptor Sakura - Eternal.summary: Tetris with Cardcaptor Sakura: Eternal Heart was released on August 10, 2000 and was published by Arika for the PlayStation 1.

Tokimeki Memorial 2 Substories - Dancing.name: Tokimeki Memorial 2 Substories: Dancing Summer Vacation
Tokimeki Memorial 2 Substories - Dancing.summary: A Visual Novel spin-off of Tokimeki Memorial 2. It includes and is centered around the fictional game "Dance Dance Revolution Tokimeki MIX".

Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six - Lone Wolf.name: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Lone Wolf
Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six - Lone Wolf.summary:
Playing as Rainbow Six team member Ding Chavez, players travel to Norway to eliminate a terrorist group planning to destabilize Eastern Europe with illegally smuggled US weapons. In keeping with the "Lone Wolf" mode of Rainbow Six assignments, missions are conducted without the help or hindrance of teammates. Planning phases include briefing, intelligence, kit select, and map screens, while actual gameplay takes place from a first-person perspective.

Weapons can be set to fully automatic (continuous), burst (three shots), or semi-automatic (one shot). Crosshair and auto-locking features provide concise control when aiming, though grenades can be used in situations requiring less precise targeting. The mission objectives, a health meter, mini-map, the currently selected weapon, and ammo status are displayed on-screen at all times. Other features in Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six: Lone Wolf include a choice of insertion points for each mission (with different advantages), night vision goggles, and an option to save after successfully completing each mission.

Truck Racing.name: Truck Racing
Truck Racing.summary: Truck Racing is a Racing game, developed by Kung Fu and published by Midas Interactive Entertainment.
